```{r}
FacebookMetrics <- read_delim(
  "dataset_Facebook.csv",
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  rename(
    page_likes = page_total_likes,
    post_month = post_month,
    post_weekday = post_weekday,
    post_hour = post_hour,
    reach = lifetime_post_total_reach,
    impressions = lifetime_post_total_impressions,
    engaged_users = lifetime_engaged_users,
    consumers = lifetime_post_consumers,
    consumptions = lifetime_post_consumptions,
    impressions_liked = lifetime_post_impressions_by_people_who_have_liked_your_page,
    reach_liked = lifetime_post_reach_by_people_who_like_your_page,
    engaged_liked = lifetime_people_who_have_liked_your_page_and_engaged_with_your_post,
    comments = comment,
    likes = like,
    shares = share,
    total_interactions = total_interactions
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type = as.factor(type),
    category = as.factor(category),
    paid = as.factor(paid)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(
    -c(type, category, paid),
    ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))
  ))

View(FacebookMetrics)

### Predicting Total Interactions Using Type, Page Total Likes, Post Month, Lifetime Post Total Reach, Lifetime Engaged Users, and Lifetime Post Consumers

# Response Variable: Total Interactions (total_interactions)
# Predictor Variables: Post Type (type), Page Total Likes (page_likes), Post Month (post_month), Lifetime Post Total Reach (reach), Lifetime Engaged Users (engaged_users), Lifetime Post Consumers (consumers)
```

```{r}
## Data Description
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# 2. Determine split size (80% training, 20% testing)
train_size <- floor(0.70 * nrow(FacebookMetrics))

# 3. Randomly sample row indices for the training set
train_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(FacebookMetrics)), size = train_size)

# 4. Create Train and Test datasets
TrainData <- FacebookMetrics[train_indices, ]
TestData  <- FacebookMetrics[-train_indices, ]
```

```{r}
# MLR Test MSE
TrueTestValues  <- TestData$total_interactions
TestPredictions <- predict(MLRModel, newdata = TestData)
test_mse_MLR   <- mean(na.omit(TrueTestValues - TestPredictions)^2)

# Polynomial Test MSE
TrueTestValues  <- TestData$total_interactions
TestPredictions <- predict(PolyModelReach, newdata = TestData)
test_mse_Poly  <- mean(na.omit(TrueTestValues - TestPredictions)^2)

test_mse_MLR
```

```{r}
## Data Description 

# Summary statistics command
summary(FacebookMetrics$total_interactions)


# Scatter plot with smooth LOWESS trend line
plot(
  FacebookMetrics$reach, 
  FacebookMetrics$total_interactions,
  xlab = "Lifetime Post Total Reach",
  ylab = "Total Interactions",
  main = "Total Interactions vs. Lifetime Post Total Reach",
  pch = 19, 
  col = "dodgerblue"
)

# Add smoothed trend line
lines(
  lowess(FacebookMetrics$reach, FacebookMetrics$total_interactions), 
  col = "firebrick", 
  lwd = 2
)


# Load required library (from lecture slide 5)
library(olsrr)

# Convert integer/character categorical variables to factors
FacebookMetrics$type <- as.factor(FacebookMetrics$type)
FacebookMetrics$category <- as.factor(FacebookMetrics$category)
FacebookMetrics$post_month <- as.factor(FacebookMetrics$post_month)
FacebookMetrics$post_weekday <- as.factor(FacebookMetrics$post_weekday)
FacebookMetrics$paid <- as.factor(FacebookMetrics$paid)


MyModel <- lm(
  total_interactions ~ page_likes + type + category + post_month + post_weekday + post_hour +paid,
  data = FacebookMetrics
)

BestSubsets <- ols_step_all_possible(MyModel)

BestSubsets

BestSubsets$result[which.min(BestSubsets$result$sbc), ]



## Forward Stepwise selection 


FacebookMetrics_clean <- na.omit(FacebookMetrics[, c("total_interactions", "page_likes", 
                                                     "type", "category", "post_month", 
                                                     "post_weekday", "post_hour", "paid")])


MyModel <- lm(
  total_interactions ~ page_likes + type + category + post_month + post_weekday + post_hour + paid,
  data = FacebookMetrics_clean
)

null_model <- lm(total_interactions ~ 1, data = FacebookMetrics_clean)

n <- nrow(FacebookMetrics_clean)
Forward_SBC <- step(
  null_model,
  scope = list(lower = null_model, upper = MyModel),
  direction = "forward",
  k = log(n)
)

BIC(Forward_SBC)


## Backward Stepwise Selection 


MyModel <- lm(
  total_interactions ~ page_likes + type + category + post_month + post_weekday + post_hour + paid,
  data = FacebookMetrics_clean
)


n <- nrow(FacebookMetrics_clean)


Backward_SBC <- step(
  MyModel,
  direction = "backward",
  k = log(n)
)

BIC(Backward_SBC)


```

```{r}
train_mse_Poly <- mean(resid(PolyModelReach)^2)
train_mse_Poly
```

```{r}
### Ridge/Lasso/Elastic Net regression 


library(glmnet)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)

df_ridge <- FacebookMetrics %>%
  select(total_interactions, page_likes, type, category, 
         post_month, post_weekday, post_hour, paid) %>%
  na.omit()


MyTrainControl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)

ridgeGrid <- expand.grid(
  alpha = 0,
  lambda = 10^seq(-2, 4, length = 100)
)

df_ridge_scaled <- df_ridge %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & -total_interactions, scale))

set.seed(123)
ridge_caret <- train(
  total_interactions ~ page_likes + type + category + post_month + post_weekday + post_hour + paid,
  data = df_ridge_scaled,
  method = "glmnet",
  tuneGrid = ridgeGrid,
  trControl = MyTrainControl
)


ridge_caret


plot(ridge_caret)


ridge_caret$bestTune$lambda

# 8. Extract estimated model coefficients (Slides 14)
coef(ridge_caret$finalModel, s = ridge_caret$bestTune$lambda)

### Lasso Regression 

df_lasso <- FacebookMetrics %>%
  select(total_interactions, page_likes, type, category, 
         post_month, post_weekday, post_hour, paid) %>%
  na.omit()

MyTrainControl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)

lassoGrid <- expand.grid(
  alpha = 1,
  lambda = 10^seq(-2, 2, length = 100)
)


df_lasso_scaled <- df_lasso %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & -total_interactions, scale))

set.seed(123)
lasso_caret <- train(
  total_interactions ~ page_likes + type + category + post_month + post_weekday + post_hour + paid,
  data = df_lasso_scaled,
  method = "glmnet",
  tuneGrid = lassoGrid,
  trControl = MyTrainControl
)

plot(lasso_caret)

lasso_caret$bestTune$lambda

# 8. Extract estimated model coefficients for the best model (Slides 21)
coef(lasso_caret$finalModel, s = lasso_caret$bestTune$lambda)

```
